asset.name: Offboarding complete
asset.description: Sent to the manager when the termination is recorded and final pay is scheduled.
asset.subject: Offboarding complete: {{employee_name}} ({{last_working_day}})
asset.html_body:
Offboarding complete

Hi {{manager_name}},

The offboarding for {{employee_name}} ({{job_title}}) is complete and recorded as {{termination_id}}.

  • Last working day: {{last_working_day}} ({{reason}})
  • Access revocation: {{revocation_timing}}{{=IF(garden_leave, ", garden leave applies", "")}}
  • Final pay: {{final_pay_date}}, including {{leave_payout_days}} days of leave
  • Eligible for rehire: {{rehire_eligible}}

Sent by your employee offboarding workflow
